finding: The prior filename identity check used substring containment, so a path could include the correct commit and role token while still carrying misleading extra prefixes, suffixes, or an overlapping role token. The gate now requires the exact basename <commit_sha>-<role_token><typed_suffix> for every retained artifact.

cases: reject primary role token overlap with primary-headers
reject prefixes before the exact commit identity
reject suffixes after the exact role identity
preserve fail-closed deployment and shell-control rejection

deployment.reason: Current operating state forbids application deployment attempts while provider build capacity is exhausted.

claim_boundary: Proves exact source behavior in a local Node test for canonical retained-evidence filenames.
Does not prove authenticated repository execution, workflow-run completeness, Vercel deployment identity, browser behavior, audio audibility, or physical iPhone Safari behavior.
